title: Brilliant excursion excellent guide
text:
One of the best excursions I've ever been on whilst away on holiday
Although it was a long day with travelling to and from  Caminito Del Rey 
The experience with the guide we had the scenery and spectacular views from the Suspended walkway made it a most memorable day
author: Gareth_V

title: Great trip, don't miss out
text: This was a fantastic trip and definitely would recommend to anyone coming to Spain. The driver was superb and our guides were fantastic on the trip there and through the mountains. They truely love their homeland and promote it so well :)
author: McKeeMoments

title: Wow! what an experience.
text:
Breathtaking experience. This is a long journey on the coach, in my opinion, well worth it. I would not like to do this experience when it is very hot. This is reviewed at the end of March 24C temperature. There are simple toilets at the start and end of this walk, which takes approximately 3 hours with a guide pointing out items of interest. Numbers are controlled over the highest bridge , you just have to wait your turn, There was also a guide near the bridge taking photos of you just in front of the bridge (free) using your device. the photos I saw were a great memento.

title: Definitely worth it

title: Great adventure
text: A great adventure and would recommend it to anyone looking to get out of the city for the day. The guides are very good and is not as scary as the pictures make it seem.
author: David_L

title: Highly recommended
text: Simply beautiful. Unique views. Very nice guides with lots of informative details. The bus tour starting from Seville was comfortable and worthwhile...
author: A2797UCrenep

title: Beautiful excursion
text:
Excursion in complete safety along a suggestive and certainly beautiful route.
Guide prepared and able to provide adequate information.
author: boroberto51

title: It's awesome.
text: I did the tour with Ray de Naturanda and loved it. It is a dizzying and beautiful experience. The photos do not do it justice.it is prettier live.
author: Niky M

title: Wonderful day
text:
We followed the excursion to Caminito del rey, with Catherine, our French guide on the Bus, She provided us with explanations before the visit, and as soon as we entered the park, it is guides who do not speak French that take over, it is a shame, Catherine accompanied us on the tour to try to translate, but it was not easy because the guide gave too many explanations to be translated live, so really shame, we just had the outline.
As for the view and sensations, just beautiful.
We walked a lot, you have to be in good shape to follow the course, but we brought back magical photos.
author: Fabienne B

title: Thanks Naturanda Turismo and Peter the excellent guide
text:
This was a stunning experience and well organised. I am particularly grateful to Peter our guide and Naturanda Turismo for helping me to leave the tour at Ardales and catch a bus to Ronda. Thanks especially Peter who found all the information I needed to do this!
Enjoy the caminito: an amazing experience!
